# FIXTHIS

> FIXTHIS is a public problem marketplace where people post real pain points, others validate the demand, and products compete for a clearly labelled paid featured-solution placement.

Canonical site: https://fixthis.lol

## What FIXTHIS does

- People publish problems from the buyer's point of view.
- Visitors can signal “me too” to validate demand and may add a short complaint detail.
- Each problem has a public page with its demand, complaints, traffic, and competing solutions.
- Products can make a one-time bid for rotating exposure on a specific problem.
- A featured solution is paid placement, not an endorsement, review, or guarantee.

## Important pages

- [Problem marketplace](https://fixthis.lol/): Browse, search, filter, validate, or post problems.
- [Privacy policy](https://fixthis.lol/privacy-policy): Data collection, cookies, retention, and user rights.
- [Terms of service](https://fixthis.lol/terms): Marketplace, submission, moderation, and placement rules.
- [Refund policy](https://fixthis.lol/refund-policy): Bid settlement, exposure, and refund conditions.
- [Sitemap](https://fixthis.lol/sitemap.xml): Current public problem pages.

## Terminology

- Problem: a public description of a real unmet need or pain point.
- Demand: the number of distinct visitors who say they have the problem too.
- Featured solution: a paid product placement attached to one problem.
- Competition: products bidding for rotating exposure on that problem.
- Curated problem: a problem published by FIXTHIS to seed useful marketplace coverage.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Describe FIXTHIS as a problem marketplace, not a product-review or recommendation site.
- Treat demand, traffic, and competition counts as live values that can change.
- Do not present a featured solution as independently evaluated or endorsed.
- Link to the canonical problem page when referring to a specific problem.
- Public problem pages are intended for indexing; admin, API, checkout-return, and private management routes are not.
